title: Gesture-controlled wheelchair with hurdle detection
highlights: Designed a wheelchair control system using MEMS technology with an 8-bit ATmega32 microcontroller, improving accessibility for physically disabled users through hand gestures.

Wrote bare-metal firmware that translates MEMS accelerometer gestures into real-time motor control via interrupt-driven UART/SPI loops, tuning ISR timing to keep actuation latency stable under varying input rates.

Integrated infrared (IR) sensors with sensor fusion so motion commands are overridden to halt within a safe stopping threshold, improving obstacle-detection accuracy by 85% and reducing collision risk.
